headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 14, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Max Meyer earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The San Diego Padres also secured a win, defeating the Baltimore Orioles 5-2 behind a strong performance from Walker Buehler. Rodolfo Durán led the Padres' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI. The Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners, winning 10-1 behind a strong performance from Miles Mikolas.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Michael Helman of the Texas Rangers, who was placed on the 10-day injured list due to an unspecified injury. The San Francisco Giants placed Keaton Winn on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 11, 2026, due to a right elbow strain. Freddy Fermin of the San Diego Padres was placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. José Ramírez of the Cleveland Guardians was placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture, while Vinnie Pasquantino of the Kansas City Royals was placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamate fracture.

The Chicago White Sox made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers also made a trade, acquiring RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Walker Buehler earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 1 ER, 0 BB, and 6 H. Rodolfo Durán led the Padres' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Mariners 10-1**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners, winning 10-1 behind a strong performance from Miles Mikolas, who pitched 7.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 8-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Camilo Doval earning the win in relief. José Caballero led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Place Michael Helman on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers have placed center fielder Michael Helman on the 10-day injured list. This move comes as the team navigates its current roster.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
